Trusses are split only at their supports (the S-04 elevations): T1 on rows B and C sits on posts at grids 1, 2, 3 (split again at C2' on row C where T4 lands); T3 spans B2-C2 between the two T1; T4 spans C2' to E2' in one piece (4.50, no post at row D). The dash-dot T1/T2 lines run on to the eaves on the plan — those tails are rafter overhang, not truss span, and are not recorded.

T2 position conflict, decided: the S-03 plan draws the porch ridge T2 about 0.25 above row E (no dimension), but the S-04 Truss T2 elevation spans 3.00 between two อะเส posts with T4 at its centre, and the T4 elevation spans exactly 4.50 = C to E. Two printed spans agree on row E (E2-E3, both columns exist), against one undimensioned drawn position -> T2 recorded on E2-E3, confidence 0.8. The porch hips then land on E2/E3 at exactly 45 degrees.

Valley section conflict, decided: the legend prints 'ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x3.2 mm.' but the leader on the valley itself prints 'ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x2.3 mm.'. The member's own callout is taken (2.3) — confidence 0.65 and flag section_conflict_legend_vs_callout; the hip leader agrees with its legend (3.2).

Hip/valley rafters carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2); spans of the diagonal members are left unresolved per section 4 (plan lengths from the grid ends given in note only).
